notes: Komorebi, a Japanese-Danish open-fire restaurant in Copenhagen. Single-file site with full 33-item menu, instant search and dietary/category filters, reservation flow with calendar and slot logic, takeaway basket with localStorage persistence and checkout, real-time open/closed status from opening hours, mobile navigation, Web Audio ambient toggle, canvas hero/story/gallery illustrations, and a hidden chef's dish easter egg. No external assets beyond Google Fonts.
